assertions.name: one chapter edit does not rewrite whole library
one chapter edit does not rewrite other books or request snapshots
desktop input P95 is at most 100ms
opening settings and scrolling do not write book data
idle close performs no library writes
early chapter draft survives real reload
the latest input is durable before the ordinary debounce fires
startup does not load non-current book snapshots
non-current snapshot loads on demand and survives a later save
full export and book snapshot include every lazy request
lazy deletion removes only the chosen request from disk and list
missing records and invalid manifest reject instead of loading an incomplete library
an interrupted write rolls back every changed record and its manifest
startup median improves by at least 30 percent
book switching median improves by at least 30 percent

note: Prior failed comparison; final accepted comparison is a paired baseline and current run with 9 samples each.
